owner_report: Visible buttons activated only when clicking below the cursor target. User report was ground truth.
root_cause: Qt 6.4.2 Wayland selected Bradient client-decoration margins (3,30,3,3). The Vulkan window did not composite those decorations; its content pixels started at surface origin. Native pointer dispatch nevertheless subtracted the margins, sending clicks 3px left and 30px above their visible targets.
fix: main.cpp supplies a Wayland-only frameless initial property before QML/native window creation. Windows/XCB retain ordinary window flags.

Main.qml uses that policy for window flags and delegates blank-chrome dragging and four-pixel edge/corner grips to QWindow startSystemMove/startSystemResize. No pointer offsets or per-control compensations.
Policy is passed as an initial QML property, rather than observing Window.flags: Qt 6.4 flags has no QML change notification.

feedback_loop.method: Temporary Linux evdev /dev/uinput absolute mouse device sends through kernel/libinput/compositor/wl_pointer. A read-only LD_PRELOAD probe observes raw wl_pointer positions and delivered QMouseEvent positions. The compositor-visible Tools button center is clicked, and actual Tools opening is asserted. No QTest mouse injection or forced Qt.Tool flags.
feedback_loop.isolation: Changing only per-window decoration policy eliminated the offset; subsequent QML additions preserved OS move/resize. Same physical loop passed again after actual native window move and resize.
feedback_loop.regression_test_limit: Headless/QTest-injected UI tests bypass this exact failing seam. This is a real OS-level smoke regression on the reproducing host, not a portable CI unit test. Temporary instrumentation/reproducer removed after capture; native input acceptance must continue to exercise this boundary.

compositor_captures.method: cosmic-screenshot --interactive=false --modal=false --notify=false; cropped to the Nemo surface only. Unrelated desktop pixels were not retained. Client capture of the physically opened appearance popup is also retained.

limitations: Physical run scoped to the reproducing COSMIC Wayland DPR=1 host. No Windows/mixed-DPI physical input run claimed.
Existing vendor warnings (Qt qmldir scanner and minizip-ng mktemp linker warning) unchanged.
This fixes the reported pointer defect; owner appearance/interaction approval of #59 is still pending.
